I replied to Dana in the DM: her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38. I checked the DM history first. She set it on Oct 14 and hasn't changed it there since.

One thing to know: the summary I wrote at the end of the last turn ended up in that DM as a message to Dana. It's written about her in the third person, so it reads oddly, but it contains nothing she didn't already know.
